rewrites.//: SPA fallback for real routes, but NOT for /assets. It used to be /(.*): Vercel checks the filesystem first, so an asset that exists is served directly, but a hashed chunk from a previous build no longer exists and fell through to this rule, coming back 200 with index.html. The browser will not run HTML as a module, so every lazy route threw 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module' and the user hit the error boundary on a page that was fine. Excluding /assets makes a stale chunk 404 honestly, which is what src/lib/lazy-route.ts recovers from.
